metadata.title: Auto Loan Bi-Weekly Payment Calculator
metadata.description: Calculate bi-weekly auto loan payments, total interest, total amount paid, and a monthly-equivalent comparison. Supports trade-in negative equity, sales tax, dealer fees, APR vs interest rate terminology, and an optional Total Cost of Ownership view. Uses conservative rounding and clearly states accuracy caveats versus lender schedules.

aprVsInterestRate.title: APR vs. Interest Rate
aprVsInterestRate.text: Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is a broader measure of borrowing cost than the nominal interest rate. APR may include certain prepaid finance charges and other amounts as defined by applicable law and your lender’s disclosures. This calculator provides estimates for budgeting and comparison and is not a credit offer.

estimatesNotOffer.title: Estimates; Not a Contract
estimatesNotOffer.text: Results are estimates based on inputs and standard amortization math. Lender calculations may differ due to rounding, payment timing conventions, fee treatment, and contract-specific rules. Always rely on your loan contract and lender disclosures for final payment amounts and APR.

paymentTiming.title: Payment Timing Assumption
paymentTiming.text: Bi-weekly assumes 26 payments per year (every 14 days). Some lenders use semi-monthly schedules (24 payments per year), which produce different results.

financeChargeNote.title: Finance Charge and Amount Financed (High-Level)
financeChargeNote.text: This tool estimates amount financed and interest paid using a standard fixed-rate amortization model. It does not compute a legally compliant Finance Charge or APR from first principles for all contract variants. For legal disclosures, use lender-provided Truth in Lending disclosures.

dataPrivacy.privacyConsentLabel: I understand results are estimates and I consent to the processing of inputs on this device for calculation purposes.

2026_market_rate_table.description: Optional: lender/market APR ranges by credit score tier and term. Populate with your vetted dataset and citations.

zip_tax_fee_lookup.description: Optional: sales tax rate and typical DMV/dealer fee ranges by ZIP/state/county.

fields.label: Vehicle purchase price
fields.ariaLabel: Vehicle purchase price in dollars
fields.helpText: Enter the negotiated purchase price before taxes and fees. Excludes trade-in adjustments.
fields.errorText: Enter a vehicle price of 0 or more.

fields.label: Down payment
fields.ariaLabel: Down payment amount in dollars
fields.helpText: Cash paid upfront that reduces the amount financed. Does not include trade-in value.
fields.errorText: Down payment must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Trade-in value
fields.ariaLabel: Trade in value in dollars
fields.helpText: Value credited for your trade-in. If you still owe money on the trade-in, enter that separately.
fields.errorText: Trade-in value must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Amount owed on trade-in
fields.ariaLabel: Amount owed on trade in vehicle in dollars
fields.helpText: If you owe more than the trade-in is worth, the difference (negative equity) may be added to the new loan.
fields.errorText: Amount owed must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Sales tax rate
fields.ariaLabel: Sales tax rate percentage
fields.helpText: If you know your sales tax rate, enter it. Otherwise you may use ZIP lookup if available.
fields.errorText: Sales tax rate must be between 0% and 20%.

fields.label: ZIP code (optional lookup)
fields.ariaLabel: ZIP code for tax and fee lookup
fields.helpText: Optional. If enabled, can prefill sales tax and typical registration/title fees for your area.
fields.errorText: Enter a valid ZIP code (e.g., 94105 or 94105-1234).

fields.label: Dealer fees (doc, prep, add-ons)
fields.ariaLabel: Total dealer fees in dollars
fields.helpText: Enter dealer-related fees you expect to pay. If fees are financed, they increase amount financed.
fields.errorText: Dealer fees must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Government fees (title, registration)
fields.ariaLabel: Title and registration fees in dollars
fields.helpText: DMV/title/registration fees. Depending on your contract, these may be paid upfront or financed.
fields.errorText: Government fees must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Finance taxes and fees into loan?
fields.ariaLabel: Toggle whether taxes and fees are included in the loan amount
fields.helpText: If enabled, taxes and fees increase the amount financed. If disabled, they are treated as paid upfront.
fields.errorText: Select whether taxes and fees are financed.

fields.label: Interest rate (nominal)
fields.ariaLabel: Nominal annual interest rate percentage
fields.helpText: The nominal interest rate used to compute periodic interest. If you only know APR, enter it in APR and leave this equal to APR.
fields.errorText: Interest rate must be between 0% and 35%.

fields.label: APR (Annual Percentage Rate)
fields.ariaLabel: Annual percentage rate APR
fields.helpText: APR may reflect certain prepaid finance charges per lender disclosures. This calculator uses APR as the financing rate input unless you explicitly model charges separately.
fields.errorText: APR must be between 0% and 35%.

fields.label: Rate input mode

options.label: Use APR as the amortization rate (common estimate)
Use nominal interest rate as the amortization rate

fields.ariaLabel: Select whether to use APR or nominal interest rate for payment calculations
fields.helpText: For most consumer comparisons, using APR is acceptable as an estimate. For contract-accurate schedules, use the contract rate and exact fee treatment.
fields.errorText: Select a rate input mode.

fields.label: Loan term
fields.ariaLabel: Loan term in months
fields.helpText: Typical auto terms range from 24 to 84 months. Bi-weekly calculations convert months to an equivalent number of bi-weekly payments.
fields.errorText: Enter a loan term between 6 and 96 months.

fields.label: Credit score tier (optional)
fields.ariaLabel: Credit score tier selection
fields.helpText: If provided and a market rate table is configured, the calculator can suggest a typical APR range for your tier and term.
fields.errorText: Select a credit score tier or leave as not specified.

fields.label: Origination fee (if applicable)
fields.ariaLabel: Origination fee in dollars
fields.helpText: Some lenders charge an origination fee. If financed, it increases amount financed; if paid upfront, it increases cash due at signing.
fields.errorText: Origination fee must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Finance origination fee into loan?
fields.ariaLabel: Toggle whether origination fee is included in loan amount
fields.helpText: If enabled, the fee increases amount financed and interest cost; if disabled, it is treated as upfront cash.
fields.errorText: Select whether origination fee is financed.

fields.label: Extra payment each bi-weekly period
fields.ariaLabel: Extra payment per biweekly period in dollars
fields.helpText: Optional extra amount added to each scheduled bi-weekly payment. If enabled, the calculator can estimate payoff acceleration via re-amortization.
fields.errorText: Extra payment must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Extra payment modeling

options.label: Do not re-amortize (show scheduled totals only)
Estimate early payoff with extra payments (approx.)

fields.ariaLabel: Select how extra payments are modeled
fields.helpText: Re-amortization uses a simulated period-by-period payoff estimate. Lender payoff quotes may differ due to daily interest and fee rules.
fields.errorText: Select an extra payment modeling method.

fields.label: Include Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) estimate
fields.ariaLabel: Toggle total cost of ownership estimate
fields.helpText: Adds non-financing costs (insurance, fuel, maintenance, registration, depreciation) to estimate broader ownership cost.
fields.errorText: Select whether to include TCO.

fields.label: TCO horizon
fields.ariaLabel: Total cost of ownership horizon in years
fields.helpText: How long you plan to keep the car for the TCO estimate. Often matches loan term, but can differ.
fields.errorText: Enter a horizon between 1 and 10 years.

fields.label: Annual insurance cost
fields.ariaLabel: Annual insurance cost in dollars
fields.helpText: Optional. If you don’t know, leave blank or 0 and treat TCO as incomplete.
fields.errorText: Annual insurance cost must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Annual maintenance & repairs
fields.ariaLabel: Annual maintenance and repair cost in dollars
fields.helpText: Oil, tires, scheduled maintenance, and expected repairs (average).
fields.errorText: Annual maintenance cost must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Annual fuel/energy cost
fields.ariaLabel: Annual fuel or energy cost in dollars
fields.helpText: Gasoline/diesel or electricity cost per year for driving.
fields.errorText: Annual fuel cost must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Annual registration & vehicle taxes
fields.ariaLabel: Annual registration and vehicle taxes in dollars
fields.helpText: Recurring registration fees and recurring vehicle taxes (not sales tax at purchase).
fields.errorText: Annual registration and taxes must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Annual depreciation estimate
fields.ariaLabel: Annual depreciation estimate in dollars
fields.helpText: Optional. A simple way is (purchase price − expected resale value) ÷ years held.
fields.errorText: Annual depreciation must be 0 or more.

fields.label: Privacy consent
fields.ariaLabel: Privacy consent checkbox
fields.helpText: Required to run the calculator. Inputs are processed on this device unless otherwise stated.
fields.errorText: Consent is required to run calculations.

derived.label: Taxable base (purchase components subject to sales tax)
derived.notes: Jurisdiction rules vary; some states tax the price net of trade-in, others do not. Treat as an estimate.

derived.label: Amount financed (principal)
derived.expression: max(0, vehicle_purchase_price - down_payment_amount - trade_in_value + amount_owed_on_trade_in + fees_and_tax_financed + origination_fee_financed_amount)

derived.label: Number of bi-weekly payments
derived.notes: This converts months to an equivalent count of bi-weekly periods. Contracts may define payment counts differently.

outputs.label: Early payoff estimate (if extra payments modeled)
Total Cost of Ownership (estimate)
outputs.expression: (enable_total_cost_of_ownership ? ((tco_years * (annual_insurance_cost + annual_maintenance_cost + annual_fuel_cost + annual_registration_taxes + annual_depreciation_estimate)) + (extra_payment_enabled ? total_paid_with_extra_est : total_paid_scheduled) + (fees_financed ? 0 : (sales_tax_amount + dealer_fees_total + government_fees_total)) + (origination_fee_financed ? 0 : origination_fee)) : 0)
outputs.notes: TCO is an estimate. If any annual inputs are left at 0, treat TCO as incomplete rather than authoritative.

shortMethodology: This tool estimates a fixed-rate installment loan with bi-weekly payments (26 per year).
Amount financed includes purchase price adjustments, negative equity (if any), and optionally financed taxes/fees and origination fee.
Scheduled payment uses the standard amortizing loan annuity formula; optional extra payment can be simulated period-by-period for an early payoff estimate.
